    StartersLights-out tomato soup and cheese toastiesCheddar toasties fried in butter and cut into fingers, with cups of roast tomato soup for dunkingHow to make it1kg ripe tomatoes, halved1 onion, chopped3 garlic cloves2 tbsp olive oil500ml vegetable stock1 tsp sugar1 tsp salt8 slices of white bread200g cheddar, grated40g butter, softHeat the oven to 200°C. Toss 1kg halved tomatoes, the onion and garlic with 2 tbsp olive oil in a roasting tin.Roast until soft and catching at the edges.Blend with 500ml vegetable stock, the sugar and salt, then simmer in a pot.Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread and fill 4 sandwiches with 200g grated cheddar.Toast in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted, in batches.Cut into fingers and serve with the soup in cups.Freddy's striped jumper skewersCherry tomatoes, basil, bocconcini and green olives threaded in stripes, with balsamic glazeHow to make it250g cherry tomatoes220g baby bocconcini, drained1 bunch basil16 large green olives, pitted2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil2 tbsp balsamic glaze1/2 tsp sea salt flakes16 small skewersThread a cherry tomato, a basil leaf, a bocconcini and an olive onto each skewer, repeating so the red and green alternate.Lay on a platter, drizzle with the olive oil and balsamic glaze and sprinkle with salt.Main MealFreddy's boiler room Salisbury steakBeef and onion patties in a rich mushroom gravy with buttery mash and peasHow to make it600g beef mince50g breadcrumbs1 egg1 onion, finely diced, for the patties1 onion, sliced, for the gravy1 tsp salt1/2 tsp black pepper1 tbsp vegetable oil250g mushrooms, sliced2 tbsp plain flour1 tbsp tomato paste500ml beef stock1kg floury potatoes, peeled and chopped60g butter100ml milk300g frozen peasMix 600g beef mince with the breadcrumbs, egg, diced onion, half the salt and the pepper, and shape into 4 thick ovals.Brown the patties in the oil for 4 minutes a side and set aside.Fry the sliced onion and mushrooms in the same pan until golden.Stir in the flour and tomato paste, add 500ml beef stock a little at a time, then return the patties and simmer covered. Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender.Drain and mash the potatoes with the butter, milk and the rest of the salt, and cook the peas.Serve the patties and gravy over the mash with the peas.DessertKristen's 1428 Elm Street gingerbread housesGingerbread 1428 Elm Streets, iced white. Watch the windows at the very endHow to make it125g butter, soft100g brown sugar125ml golden syrup1 egg, separated300g plain flour1 tsp bicarbonate of soda2 tsp ground ginger1 tsp ground cinnamon1/4 tsp ground cloves200g icing sugar1 tsp lemon juiceBeat the butter and brown sugar until pale, then beat in the golden syrup and egg yolk.Sift in the flour, bicarb, ginger, cinnamon and cloves and mix to a soft dough.Wrap and chill.Heat the oven to 180°C. Roll the dough 4mm thick between sheets of baking paper and cut into house shapes with a knife and a card template.Bake until firm at the edges.Cool on a rack.Beat the icing sugar with the egg white and lemon juice until stiff, then pipe on roof lines, windows and a front door.DrinksWestin Hills stay-awake iced coffeeCold brew, vanilla and milk on ice, for Kristen, who fights the orderlies to stay awakeHow to make it100g ground coffee, coarse800ml cold water60g caster sugar60ml hot water1 tsp vanilla extract250ml cold milk1 bag iceStir 100g coarse ground coffee into 800ml cold water, cover and refrigerate overnight.Strain through a paper filter.Stir the sugar into 60ml hot water until dissolved, add the vanilla and cool.Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the cold brew and syrup and finish with a splash of cold milk.Hot malted milkWarm malted milk and honey.
